paragraphs: The products with greatest export potential from Kenya to Saudi Arabia are Black tea, packings >3kg, Cut roses & buds, fresh and Coffee, not roasted, not decaffeinated.
Kenya has the highest supply capacity in Black tea, packings >3kg. Medicaments for retail sale, n.e.s. is the product that faces the strongest demand potential in Saudi Arabia.
